''See also: [[Elder Rahm Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Elder Rahm is an elder at the Heaven’s Glory School{{!}}Heaven's Glory School who serves as the overseer for all three of the institution's Treasure Halls, including the [[Lesser Treasure Hall]]. Although he appears to be at least eighty years old and possesses a hunched, aged physique that requires the use of a cane, he has demonstrated the vitality of a much younger man. He is a knowledgeable figure who advises disciples on selecting significant treasures to aid their [[advancement]], emphasizing the importance of choosing items that will remain useful even as they reach higher levels of power. Rahm is characterized by a deep distrust of outsiders and can be quite stubborn when opposing them. While he has shown moments of mentorship and protection toward certain disciples, he is also capable of intense anger and can be quite intimidating. His past experiences include a confrontation with a [[Sage]] that resulted in a lasting spiritual injury. In combat or high-tension situations, he has been seen wielding a slender [[sword]] that remains steady despite his age.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|As a [[Jade]] and an Elder of the [[Heaven’s Glory School]], Rahm serves as the keeper of the [[Lesser Treasure Hall]]. His position follows a previous battle that caused extensive [[destruction]] to the interior of his hall. During an encounter, he stood behind [[Yerin]] and expressed pity for [[Lindon]] while warning that his [[Remnant]] would take action if he were killed. Despite the presence of others, Rahm refused to bow to [[Eithan]].}}
